dimensions.name: layout_readability
dimensions.description: Whether the visible page layout is readable without overlap, clipping, excessive crowding, or mobile unreadability.
dimensions.score_5: The visible layout is clear, key content is readable, and text is not overlapped, clipped, or cramped.
dimensions.score_3: Mostly readable, but some visible areas are cramped, too small, or require effort to interpret.
dimensions.score_1: Blank, severely overlapped, clipped, or unreadable, especially on mobile.

dimensions.name: algorithm_state_visibility
dimensions.description: Whether the screenshot makes the current data structure, target, processed/unprocessed portions, paths, pointers, intervals, or dependencies visible.
dimensions.score_5: Key algorithm state is clearly visible and distinguishable.
dimensions.score_3: Some state is visible, but important objects require inference or reading much surrounding text.
dimensions.score_1: The current algorithm state is missing or not visually identifiable.

dimensions.name: teaching_explanation
dimensions.description: Whether visible explanations support learning the current step, including reasons, formulas, before/after state, and boundary feedback.
dimensions.score_5: The visible explanation is concrete and aligned with the current step.
dimensions.score_3: There is an explanation, but it is generic or incomplete.
dimensions.score_1: Explanation is absent, too vague, or visibly mismatched with the state.

dimensions.name: interaction_affordance
dimensions.description: Whether controls such as play, step, prediction, input, formula expansion, judge, or dependency clicks are visible and their feedback is discoverable.
dimensions.score_5: Interaction entry points and feedback are visible and clear.
dimensions.score_3: Interactions exist but are not prominent or feedback is weak.
dimensions.score_1: Interaction is missing, not discoverable, or feedback is visibly inconsistent.

dimensions.name: evidence_alignment
dimensions.description: Whether visible evidence, targets, dependencies, formulas, and validation summaries agree with the displayed step. Do not judge algorithm correctness beyond visible alignment.
dimensions.score_5: Visible evidence and displayed state are internally aligned.
dimensions.score_3: Mostly aligned, but evidence is weak or requires inference.
dimensions.score_1: Visible evidence appears absent or inconsistent with the displayed state.

dimensions.name: overall_teaching_quality
dimensions.description: Whether the screenshot would work as a teaching demo or paper figure based only on visible content.
dimensions.score_5: Strong teaching screenshot that can support understanding the current step.
dimensions.score_1: Not suitable for teaching or paper evidence.

screenshot_types.dashboard: Focus on overview readability, table/card density, status visibility, desktop/mobile scanability, and whether benchmark evidence is visible.
screenshot_types.page: Focus on algorithm state, explanation, step controls, visible evidence, and desktop/mobile readability.
screenshot_types.interaction: Focus on the specific interaction state, whether feedback after the interaction is clear, and whether controls remain discoverable.

low_score_conditions: empty or invisible canvas where a visual state should appear
interaction feedback is not visible or unclear
visible evidence is missing or contradictory
